items.title: Implement fix for reproduced failure

happy.desc: The reproduced M2-M4 gap is closed by code and documented acceptance evidence.

edge.desc: Existing M1 checkpoint-resume behavior remains intact after the new M2-M4 layer.

adversarial.desc: The story does not turn candidate repro evidence into DONE evidence; green evidence is produced by DEV/TEST commands.

items.userSees: User sees "autopilot-v2 reliability smoke passed: M2 health, M3 throttle, M4 fencing verified" and the final acceptance table marks the reproduced gap closed.

items.title: Implement M3 adaptive runtime throttle semantics
items.context: Add bounded local runtime throttle logic with maxConcurrentLive, throttle_hold/throttle_raise/throttle_backoff events, stable-window raise, and overload/rate-limit backoff. Bind to Autopilot v2 M3 without claiming live fleet scale.
items.userSees: User sees "M3 adaptive throttle: PASS" in the Autopilot v2 acceptance table and smoke output.

happy.desc: maxConcurrentLive prevents more live dispatches than configured.

edge.desc: A stable window raises cautiously toward the cap; overload/rate-limit windows increase delay/backoff.

adversarial.desc: Invalid or zero maxConcurrentLive values clamp to a safe minimum and never allow unbounded concurrency.

items.title: Implement M4 process-pool claim lease and fencing semantics
items.context: Add bounded local process-pool coordination primitives: ownerWorkerId, leaseId, leaseExpiresAt, fencingToken, duplicate claim refusal, expired lease takeover, and stale worker commit refusal. Bind to Autopilot v2 M4 as control-plane semantics.
items.userSees: autopilot-v2 reliability table shows M4 process-pool claim/lease/fencing PASS with duplicate-claim and stale-fencing smoke evidence.

happy.desc: N independent units can be claimed by distinct workers and completed once each under a bounded pool.

edge.desc: Expired claims can be taken over with a newer fencing token.

adversarial.desc: A stale worker with an old fencing token cannot commit after a newer claim exists.

items.title: Update Autopilot v2 execution-plan status and acceptance table
items.context: Revise autopilot-v2-reliability-execution-plan.md from stale PLANNED/backlog language to a current milestone ledger: M1 DONE via B-c7e2, M2-M4 completed by this story, with tests, commands, evidence boundaries, and limitations.
items.userSees: The document has a detailed acceptance table showing each feature, implementation status, test script, command, and PASS/scope note.

happy.desc: Document status reflects M1 DONE plus this story M2-M4 completion and no longer says the whole program is PLANNED/backlog.

edge.desc: The table distinguishes local deterministic control-plane proof from live multi-day provider fleet proof.

adversarial.desc: The doc does not reintroduce Authority Server production receipt claims or process immortality overclaim.

items.title: Run build smoke validation and version bump
items.context: Compile the CLI, run the dedicated Autopilot v2 reliability smoke plus existing Autopilot M1/run smokes, record verification evidence, merge DONE, and bump CLI patch version because runtime behavior changes.
items.userSees: Final response lists build, autopilot-v2-reliability-smoke, autopilot-resume-smoke, autopilot-run-smoke, validate/DONE-required evidence, version bump, and final PASS table.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build passes after runtime changes.

edge.desc: Existing M1 resume and autopilot run smokes still pass after the new reliability layer.

adversarial.desc: Version bump is applied exactly once after merge-worthy runtime behavior changes.

items.title: Implement M2 health-aware pause/resume semantics
items.context: Add shared Autopilot/provider failure classification and paused/waiting state projection so transient 429/503/529/network/timeout routes to health-aware pause/resume while auth/quota/policy/terminal errors remain non-transient. Bind to docs/requirements/decisions/autopilot-v2-reliability-execution-plan.md M2.
items.userSees: autopilot-v2 reliability table shows M2 health-aware pause/resume PASS with a smoke command and events health_probe/provider_unhealthy/waiting_for_provider_health/paused_requires_resume/health_recovered/resumed.

happy.desc: Transient 429/network failures classify as retryable and produce waiting/paused health events instead of generic failed step status.

edge.desc: auth_required, quota_exhausted, policy_blocked, and terminal_step_error are not treated as transient provider overload.

adversarial.desc: Legacy gemini is not used as current third-host baseline; current hosts are codex, claude-code, and antigravity/agy.
